description.value: Ucluelet Co-op is a locally-owned member cooperative affiliated with Federated Co-operatives, serving the small Vancouver Island community of Ucluelet on the wild west coast. As one of the few grocery options in this remote surf and hiking destination, it serves as a critical resupply point for touring cyclists on routes like the Pacific Rim. The co-op model means profits stay local, and membership is open to the community.
